scope: Phase 2E Iberia clean-border balance review after observer feedback
observer_feedback: Castile still dominated much of Iberia after the Phase 2D Andalusia requirement patch.
Portugal took some southern Spanish land.
Some Iberian borders looked ugly after early wars.
Castile and Portugal started with Atlantic islands in vanilla-inherited province history.
Castile began colonizing some of Africa.
Portugal colonized Brazil and conquered Morocco.

project_crown_starting_claims.finding: Project Crown does not give Castile, Granada, or Portugal broad southern-Spain or Portuguese-land starting claims. Portugal and Al-Gharb only have local split claims.

castile_portugal_border.finding: Castile has no Project Crown claim on Portugal, and Project Crown Spain formation still excludes alentejo_area and beieras_area from permanent claims. Castile taking Portuguese land is most likely opportunistic AI conquest after wars, not a Project Crown claim incentive.
castile_portugal_border.tuning: No Castile claim was added and no Portugal claim was added. A starting Castile-Portugal alliance was intentionally not added because it could pull Portugal into Castile's offensive wars and worsen Portuguese land-taking in southern Spain.

portugal_southern_spain.finding: Portugal starts with claims on Al-Gharb only. After conquering Al-Gharb or joining wars, normal AI conquest/fabrication can carry Portugal into Granadan southern Spain. Vanilla Portuguese missions also include later Iberian intervention logic.
portugal_southern_spain.tuning: No new Portuguese southern-Spain claims were added. The Portugal-Al-Gharb local claims remain because they support the intended Portuguese/Al-Gharb contest.

muslim_iberian_viability.finding: Granada is strong but Al-Gharb is small and isolated against Portugal. The observer feedback asks for Muslim nations to have a real chance without freezing aggression.
muslim_iberian_viability.tuning: Added mutual GRA/AGH historical friendship and a starting GRA-AGH alliance. POR/AGH and CAS/GRA rivalries remain, so wars are still likely.

vanilla_mission_leakage.finding: Project Crown has no mission overrides. Vanilla Portuguese and Spanish/Granadan mission trees still provide colonial, Moroccan, Iberian, and post-formation claim incentives.
vanilla_mission_leakage.tuning: No broad mission rewrite was applied in Phase 2E. The watch output identifies future mission gating candidates.

diplomacy: Added historical_friend = AGH to GRA history.
Added historical_friend = GRA to AGH history.
Added a starting GRA-AGH alliance in history/diplomacy/project_crown_iberia.txt.
claims: Spain formation claim exclusion for Portuguese areas was left intact.
forts_development_ownership: No Iberian mainland province ownership changed.

risks: The GRA-AGH alliance may make early Portugal-Al-Gharb conquest less common and may increase Granada's chance to survive.
If Castile still dominates repeatedly, later tuning may need small minor-state diplomacy or mission gating rather than province redistribution.
If Portugal still takes Granadan southern Spain too often, later tuning should inspect specific wars and mission completions from observer saves.
